import time, gre2d
import pge2py as pge2
from pge2py import pulseg
seq = gre2d.gre2d()
t=time.time(); psq = pulseg.fromSeq(seq); print(psq); print(f"FROMSEQ {time.time()-t:.1f} s")

sys_ge = pge2.opts(100e-6, 100e-6, 0.25, 5, 20, "xrm")
t=time.time(); params = pge2.check(psq, sys_ge); print(params); print(f"CHECK {time.time()-t:.1f} s")

t=time.time(); print(pge2.validate(psq, sys_ge, seq)); p = pge2.serialize(psq, "gre2d.pge", pislquant=10, params=params); print(p, p.stat().st_size); print(f"VALIDATE+SERIALIZE {time.time()-t:.1f} s")

from pge2py import aio
print(await aio.check(psq, sys_ge))
print("VALIDATE done")
